nom: Banila Co Overnight Soothing Cica Sleeping Mask

avis.texte: One thing i worry about with sleeping masks is if they will be sticky or mess with my pillow. This mask did neither of those things. It sinks in well into my skin with it feeling hydrated and not sticky or wet. In the morning my skin still feels nourished and soft! I have very sensitive skin that needs to be calmed at times and this provides the best cooling feeling when my skin feels enflamed
